option_relations.rationale: The clinical presentation and histopathologic findings, including the presence of myeloperoxidase-positive cells, are consistent with leukemia cutis (myeloid sarcoma), which is equivalent to the leaf disease myeloid sarcoma.
The clinical presentation and laboratory findings do not strongly support Sweet's syndrome (acute febrile neutrophilic dermatosis) as the most likely diagnosis.
The clinical presentation and laboratory findings do not strongly support Sweet syndrome (atypical/neutropenic) as the most likely diagnosis.
The clinical presentation and laboratory findings do not strongly support histiocytoid Sweet syndrome as the most likely diagnosis.
